levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد

notes: «قال سفيان سمعت زبيدا يحدث بهذا» is a second isnad for the same saying: Sufyan (the shared head) heard Zubayd, so a second group (rule 4, rule 5).
«بهذا الحديث» closes the first route as a back_reference, as «بهذا» does in other Sunni chains.
The Tirmidhi's dialogue with «عبد الله بن عثمان» and the jurists' ruling after it are commentary, not chain.
